pure-announcement.rationale: It is the abstract of a research paper introducing a training technique, not a product launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: The RAG concept is the only adjacent neighbour and it covers retrieval architecture, not the nested multi-granularity embedding technique MRL introduces.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The paper's claims come with open-sourced code and pretrained models on GitHub plus quantified ImageNet results a reader can reproduce.

durability.rationale: The mechanism — train one embedding whose prefixes are usable low-dimensional representations — has outlived the 2022 paper, becoming the basis for truncatable embedding APIs and adaptive retrieval since.

actionability.rationale: A builder can adopt the MRL loss with minimal pipeline change or exploit truncatable embeddings for cheaper storage and retrieval, a concrete cost-accuracy lever in embedding system design.

atomicity.rationale: It carries one idea — encode coarse-to-fine information so a single embedding adapts to varying compute budgets — statable in a paragraph.
